##### Project general facts

Serene Condo Layan is a contemporary residential development located near the peaceful shores of Layan Beach, offering a perfect balance of tropical tranquility, modern comfort, and convenient island living. Designed with a focus on elegant architecture and functional layouts, the project creates a relaxing atmosphere ideal for both permanent residence and holiday investment. Buildings are characterised by clean white concrete facades, dramatic vertical louvres, and abundant green walls and rooftop gardens that blur the boundary between the built environment and the surrounding tropical forest.

The Momentum District is designed around an extraordinary network of community hubs, each purpose-built to enrich daily life in a completely different dimension. The Business Hub provides a professional environment for entrepreneurs, startups, and digital nomads, complete with coworking areas and conference rooms, while the Gastronomic Hub offers a carefully curated collection of restaurants, cafes, and bakeries celebrating global cuisine in a warm and sociable setting. The Entertainment Hub delivers family play areas, children's playgrounds, and recreation spaces for social gatherings, and the Wellness Hub provides a serene sanctuary for yoga, mindfulness, and holistic wellbeing, all set within lush, green-roofed architecture adorned with cascading tropical vegetation. Residents and guests also enjoy direct access to Hotel The Momentum, a boutique hotel with premium concierge services available exclusively to the community.

The development features stylish condominium units with thoughtfully designed interiors, maximizing natural light and open living spaces. High-quality materials, modern finishes, and practical layouts provide residents with comfort and sophistication in every detail. Many units offer spacious balconies and scenic views of the surrounding greenery, creating a calm and private retreat. The overall aesthetic — calm, sophisticated, and deeply connected to its natural setting — creates a living environment that feels as restorative as it is refined.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

The Layan area of Phuket is one of the island's most coveted and tranquil addresses, nestled between rolling tropical forest and protected natural zones that ensure a sense of permanence and unspoiled beauty. The landscape here is extraordinary — dense jungle canopy, gentle hills, and the glittering turquoise waters of the Andaman Sea visible from elevated vantage points across the neighbourhood. Layan, Bang Tao, and Banana beaches are all moments away, offering pristine stretches of white sand and a sense of seclusion that is increasingly rare on the island.

This part of northern Phuket places residents within effortless reach of the island's most celebrated lifestyle destinations, including the Anantara Beach Club, Xana Beach Club, Laguna Golf Club, and Banyan Tree Phuket, all virtually on the doorstep. Porto de Phuket and Boat Avenue provide a vibrant dining and retail scene, while leading international schools including UWC Thailand, the International British School, and Headstart International School are comfortably accessible. Phuket International Airport is reachable in a short drive, making the location ideal for globally connected residents and investors who value both escape and accessibility.

Layan is widely regarded as Phuket's most desirable enclave for high-end living, drawing a sophisticated international community that values privacy, nature, and world-class amenities in equal measure. The area's strict environmental protections and limited land supply ensure that it will remain one of the island's most exclusive and least overdeveloped destinations for generations to come. For investors, the combination of Phuket's booming tourism market, the area's strong rental demand from premium travellers, and the irreplaceable quality of the natural surroundings makes Layan one of Southeast Asia's most compelling long-term real estate propositions.
